title: First passenger train between Bombay and Thane
description: The official historical account dates the opening to 16 April 1853. This event predates the quantitative series.

title: Rewari–Madar corridor trial
description: The Ministry described the event as a trial on the new Western Dedicated Freight Corridor section. It is distinct from dedication.

title: New Bhaupur–New Khurja
description: The government inaugurated this Eastern Dedicated Freight Corridor section. A later parliamentary answer gives a conflicting date. The dated event release and March 2021 commissioning account agree on 29 December.

title: Rewari–Madar
description: The government dedicated this Western Dedicated Freight Corridor section and flagged off an inaugural train. The first recurring commercial operation date remains unverified.
